tools.name: epc_areas
tools.description: Energy-rating (EPC) statistics for one council in England or Wales: share of homes or commercial buildings rated A to G, per postcode district. Area-level only, no addresses. Costs $0.05 per call, paid in USDC on Base with x402.

tools.name: ebay_market
tools.description: Live eBay market for one keyword on 8 eBay sites: price range with postage, seller concentration, China share, cheapest listings, optional profit from your cost. Costs $0.02 per call, paid in USDC on Base with x402.

tools.name: companies_new
tools.description: Up to 10 newly registered UK companies (Companies House) filtered by town, postcode or industry, with director, website check and email details. Costs $0.10 per call, paid in USDC on Base with x402.

tools.name: companies_overdue
tools.description: Up to 10 UK companies with overdue (or soon-due) Companies House accounts, with director and email details. Leads for accountants. Costs $0.20 per call, paid in USDC on Base with x402.

tools.name: companies_changes
tools.description: Director appointments, resignations and owner (PSC) changes at up to 20 UK companies since a date, from Companies House. Costs $0.05 per call, paid in USDC on Base with x402.

tools.name: companies_changes_feed
tools.description: New UK director appointments, resignations and owner (PSC) changes from the last 24 hours across all companies, filtered by town, postcode, industry and change type. Up to 100 rows, refreshed daily from Companies House. Costs $0.10 per call, paid in USDC on Base with x402.

tools.name: property_area
tools.description: UK property report for one postcode district in England or Wales: Land Registry sold prices by property type with change on the previous period, EPC energy ratings and police.uk crime. Area-level, no addresses. Costs $0.05 per call, paid in USDC on Base with x402.

tools.name: youtube_transcript
tools.description: The transcript of one YouTube video, Short or livestream as clean text, with title, channel, language and optional timestamped segments. Videos without captions are refused free. Costs $0.01 per call, paid in USDC on Base with x402.

tools.name: companies_changes_feed_sample
tools.description: Free: up to 3 rows from the daily UK director and owner changes feed, with the same filters as companies_changes_feed. Try before you pay.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: companies_new, tenders · Public sink: epc_areas, ebay_market, companies_new, companies_overdue, tenders.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: companies_new, tenders · Public sink: epc_areas, ebay_market, companies_new, companies_overdue, tenders

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
